static_traits.name: 林维琪
static_traits.family_status: Three siblings (elder sister, elder brother, her), she is the youngest child
static_traits.social_status: 有少数亲密朋友提供支持，但她认为朋友not完全理解其与兄弟姐妹的关系动态
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received in the past或精神科治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、能具体举例；语气偏消极与防御，倾向于Anticipation负面结果；在紧张情境下会讽刺或沉默；配合度较好

basic_info.main_problem: 我与兄弟姐妹每次见面都会争吵，导致紧张和挫败感，这种情况从小就存在，近几个月更为频繁，几乎每次Family gatherings都会发生。
basic_info.core_demands: Ongoing arguments with siblings have begun to affect my mental health and overall well-being, so I seek counseling.
growth_experiences: 童年时期即与兄弟姐妹经常争吵，这种模式延续至今；近几个月频率升高，多在Family gatherings或特殊场合发生。作为The youngest child in the family，她长期感到自己的意见not被重视，导致挫败与without力感。
在为父母周年纪念筹划活动的讨论中，她提出的点子被哥哥直接negate，not yet被考虑；争论迅速升级，使她感到努力与心意被忽视，进一步Reinforcement“我的意见not重要”的体验。

core_beliefs: I have a fundamental flaw / something is wrong with me

special_situations.event: Family gatherings或特殊场合与兄弟姐妹见面时，冲突频发
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我表达观点而not能被认可，就说明我not重要或我有问题；见面几乎必定会发生争吵
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Raises psychological defenses in advance, reduces expression, keeps distance in conversation or exits early to avoid escalation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我们见面必然会吵，without论我怎么做都without济于事

special_situations.event: 为父母周年庆讨论方案时，哥哥直接negate她的提议
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人not认可我的想法，说明我的意见have not价值
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Becomes sarcastic or chooses to stay silent to avoid further conflict
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们总是迅速negate我；我的意见not重要

special_situations.event: Has a disagreement with the older sister on viewpoints; the older sister insists she is right
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能强硬地坚持立场并清晰表达，就证明我软弱without能
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: In arguments, defensively escalates or instead goes silent for self-protection
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Either I can persevere to the end, or I am a failure

special_situations.event: During shared activities of watching movies or playing games together, briefly getting along harmoniously
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 好的互动只是偶然、微not足道，not能说明关系有改善
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeps vigilance and waits for the next argument to arrive
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些时刻not重要，很快又会吵起来

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被兄弟姐妹Listening与尊重，Gaining recognition与亲近
core_conflict.fear: 害怕表达自我会被negate或羞辱、使关系进一步恶化
defense_goal: Uses sarcasm or shutting up to reduce the risk of exposing vulnerability and maintain a sense of safety
Maintains a certain relationship distance to avoid conflict escalation

object_relations.self_representation: 被忽视、软弱、意见not被重视的最小孩子
object_relations.object_representation: 专断且轻蔑、容易negate她的兄弟姐妹

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当兄弟姐妹negate她的观点或在Family gatherings中出现冲突信号时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 对方not会Listening我的感受，表达只会让情况更糟（移情：将过往被negate的经验带入当前互动）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use简短回答、减少情感词汇与细节；语气克制，避免眼神接触，尽量退出对话以降低情绪激活。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被询问冲突的原因或被邀请尝试not同沟通方式时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将复杂的互动简化为“性格差异”，以避免触及自身被忽视的脆弱感（移情：期待他人继续negate）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use中性、抽象的语言给出看似客观的解释（如“我们性格not同”），回避个人情绪与需求的直接表述，语气冷静、理性。

manifestations: 在家庭中觉得自己的声音not被听见
争吵频发导致Strained relationships with family members
outcomes: 与朋友的互动受影响、Social withdrawal

manifestations: 认为“without论我做什么都会吵”，难以想象not同结果
将正面互动视为短暂且微not足道
outcomes: 消极期待与防御性沟通

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact.
manifestations: 在Anticipation冲突时use讽刺以Displacement或弱化直接接触
Shifting the topic to safer shared activities (movies, games) to avoid sensitive issues

contact_model.definition: The individual turns the energy originally meant to be directed outward back onto oneself (restraining or stopping outward expression).
manifestations: 在被negate后选择闭嘴、not再表达观点或需求
将愤怒与not满压回自身，减少外向表达

contact_model.definition: Has poor self-reflection with excessive self-restriction and reproach, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 质疑“我是否有问题”，自我贬低为“我not够强大”
在互动前Anticipation负面结果、过度谨慎而not敢表达

exception_events.target_problem: 在Family gatherings时，来访者通常会与兄弟姐妹陷入争吵并感到紧张与挫败，随后反复回想、影响学习与社交。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 有时在一起看电影或玩游戏等共同活动中，大家专注于活动本身，互动融洽且not yet发生争吵，来访者体验到较为轻松与愉快的氛围。
exception_events.reason: 情境not同：共同活动将注意力从敏感话题Displacement；话题not涉及个人或重要议题，减少了trigger点；因专注任务而降低了防御与负性期待。

positive_force: 能觉察并描述例外时刻与trigger条件的差异
Willing to seek counseling and try 'alternative perspectives'
In joint activities can experience positive interaction, has clues for change
negative_force: Negative expectations and overgeneralization (believing meetings will surely end in arguments)
自我贬低的核心信念（我的意见not重要；我有缺陷）
Defensive communication (sarcasm or silence) worsens interaction
家庭角色与对方沟通风格（专断、轻蔑）Reinforcement被忽视体验

target_behavior.behavior: Defensive communication: in conflict situations, becomes sarcastic or shuts down (silence, withdrawing from the conversation)
antecedent: Family gatherings或讨论重要事项时
兄弟姐妹直接negate或not考虑她的建议
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心被negate与羞辱，内含“我的意见not重要”“我not够强大”的信念以Self-protection为主
target_behavior.function: 逃避冲突升级、避免暴露脆弱与需求，短期降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Communication quality declines, relationships become estranged and arguments intensify; emotional distress increases, studies and social life are affected

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly replays argument scenes, attention hard to focus
antecedent: 想到被negate的具体事件（如父母周年庆讨论）
target_behavior.core_reason: 试图寻找解释与自我防护策略，受负性期待与without助感驱动
target_behavior.function: Tries, through rumination, to prevent being hurt next time or find a 'better response', gaining a short-term sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Intensifies stress and emotional exhaustion, affecting study efficiency and interaction with friends
